title: Detailed tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#2a4a2a' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- back pole peak -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='28' stroke='#c0a060' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- tent body - main triangular shape -->
  <polygon points='50,20 14,82 86,82' fill='#f0c040'/>
  
  <!-- right side shade for depth -->
  <polygon points='50,20 86,82 70,82' fill='#d4a030'/>
  
  <!-- left side lighter shade -->
  <polygon points='50,20 14,82 30,82' fill='#f5d060'/>
  
  <!-- door opening - dark interior -->
  <polygon points='50,40 34,82 66,82' fill='#4a3060'/>
  
  <!-- door flap left -->
  <polygon points='50,40 30,82 38,82' fill='#e8b030'/>
  
  <!-- door flap right -->
  <polygon points='50,40 70,82 62,82' fill='#c89828'/>
  
  <!-- door zip line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='50' y2='80' stroke='#f5e070' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='3,2'/>
  
  <!-- front guy rope left -->
  <line x1='14' y1='82' x2='6' y2='90' stroke='#a0c060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front guy rope right -->
  <line x1='86' y1='82' x2='94' y2='90' stroke='#a0c060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- pole peak cap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='19' r='3' fill='#e05030'/>
  
  <!-- roof ridge line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='40' stroke='#fff0a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- side guy ropes -->
  <line x1='46' y1='20' x2='30' y2='14' stroke='#a0c060' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='20' x2='70' y2='14' stroke='#a0c060' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- ground line -->
  <line x1='10' y1='82' x2='90' y2='82' stroke='#5a8a5a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- pegs -->
  <circle cx='6' cy='90' r='2' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='90' r='2' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='1.8' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='14' r='1.8' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  
  <!-- fabric folds / seam highlights on tent -->
  <line x1='38' y1='30' x2='26' y2='70' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.35' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='30' x2='74' y2='70' stroke='#a07820' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- window on right side -->
  <polygon points='66,50 76,70 60,70' fill='#80d0e0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <polygon points='66,50 76,70 60,70' fill='none' stroke='#f5e070' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
